measured_problem: Layer 0 passes alone, but layer 1 trained behind the frozen passing layer-0 prefix reaches only 0.988969 cosine and 0.140319 relative RMSE. The miss is broad across held-out capabilities, showing that small layer-0 trajectory error accumulates and cannot be corrected by independently fitting layer 1.
proposed_method: Initialize layer 0 from the passing V385 checkpoint and layer 1 from the immutable v15 artifact, jointly refit every existing parameter in both layers for one deterministic fixed-coverage epoch, and apply equal native-trajectory losses after layer 0 and layer 1. Require both boundaries independently to pass the unchanged gates before persisting a two-layer prefix.
material_differences: Optimizes the measured recurrent two-boundary system rather than an isolated downstream operator.
Retains the layer-zero local constraint explicitly instead of sacrificing it for end-prefix fit.
Changes no inference architecture, parameter count, route, or active operation.
Uses one equal-weight boundary objective with no weight, epoch, optimizer, or data sweep.
decision: Authorize exactly one separately preregistered two-boundary fit. A pass authorizes bounded extension to the next boundary; any miss closes joint-prefix conformance without parameter, width, data-scale, context, loss-weight, optimizer, epoch, route, rank, source, or gate sweeps.
claim_boundary: Architecture-review authorization only; no trained prefix, autonomous quality, runtime, Phase 3, or superiority evidence.
